attributes.title: historian_query_series
attributes.description: Query a finite bounded historical time series using system.historian.queryRawPoints. sampleCount must be positive; Natural/On-Change unbounded-style modes are forbidden.

parameters.name: paths
parameters.description: Historical paths. Hard maximum 50; each path is limited to 2048 characters.

parameters.name: startTime
parameters.description: Optional ISO-8601 instant. Defaults to 24 hours before endTime.

parameters.name: endTime
parameters.description: Optional ISO-8601 instant. Defaults to now.

parameters.name: sampleCount
parameters.description: Finite positive sample count. Default 100. paths x sampleCount may not exceed 25,000.
